name: Raul Pardo
office: El Monte Union High School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Raul Pardo is a longshoreman and a former South El Monte mayor and city council member. He says he also served as a Los Angeles County Public Health Commissioner and previously worked as a teacher and coach. He says the district faces funding challenges from declining enrollment and needs to position itself as a district of choice. He lists recruiting teachers and staff as a priority. He states that the school board’s role is to drive policy and hold the superintendent accountable for delivering on agreed policy.
